dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sadie is at risk for behavior reasons. Sadie is on-leash reactive towards unfamiliar people and other animals. She will escalate to barking and lunging. Sadie has been able to warm up with select staff members relatively quickly. Once comfortable, she can be very jumpy and mouthy. Medically, she is being treated for a urinary tract infection.

Meet Sadie! Sadie is a sweet, playful, and affectionate girl who forms deep bonds with her people and loves being part of the action. She enjoys long walks, playing with her favorite ball and stuffed animals, and cuddling up with her person. She also loves car rides and knows several basic cues. Sadie does have some challenges and can be reactive on leash toward unfamiliar people and other animals. She is a strong puller and will need an experienced, patient owner who understands reactivity and is comfortable continuing her training and helping her navigate the world. With the right person willing to provide structure, consistency, and understanding, Sadie has so much love to give!
dog.name: Sadie
